simple.meaning: קָבַר (qâbar) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to inter.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 133 times across Genesis, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, and 7 more, beginning at Genesis 15:15. Its contexts include family, family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קָבַר (H6912).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: קָבַר (qâbar) / H6912 is traced through Genesis 15:15, Genesis 23:4, Genesis 23:6, Genesis 23:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.
